name: Age Calculator
summary: Calculate exact age in years, months, and days — plus next birthday — in your browser.
description: Pick a date of birth and an optional as-of date to see precise age (Y/M/D), total days/weeks/months, and days until the next birthday. Leap years are handled correctly.

faqs.question: How is age calculated?
faqs.answer: We subtract calendar years, months, and days with borrowing (like manual age math), so results match common “exact age” calculators.

faqs.question: What about leap-day birthdays?
faqs.answer: Feb 29 births use Feb 28 in non-leap years for the next-birthday date.

faqs.question: Is my date uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Calculations run entirely in your browser.
